name: Input
blurb: Text fields with labels, hints, error states, and an expanding search.
mechanism: Native inputs, styled. The expanding search is two halves in the markup with [hidden] swapping which one shows - instant, no animation, one layout.
caveats: The expanding search moves focus on open. That is the intent, but it means a keyboard user who tabs past it lands somewhere new.
Error state must be announced, not just coloured: pair it with aria-invalid and a message the field points at.
